One last sanity look inside the sample PDF to confirm the words are really in it.I added the common modern features:
- **Spelling:** spell check as you type, using Windows' own offline dictionary, with a right-click menu of suggestions and a Check Spelling window (F7).
- **Formatting and navigation:** a format painter, a line-spacing button and a headings navigation pane.
- **Files and printing:** PDF export, printing (Print makes a PDF and opens it in your PDF viewer, where you print), and opening and saving Word (.docx) files.

As you asked, 17 free fonts now ship with the app (Lora, Merriweather, Roboto, Inter and others, all under a free licence that allows redistribution). The font box is now a wider, searchable list grouped into Serif, Sans Serif, Monospace and Handwriting, with each name shown in its own font. One installed font, Cambria, is hidden because the app can't read the file format Windows stores it in.
